description: One bounded original English source passage reviewed for each remaining short answer, with explicit unsupported scope. NOT final EN/FR claim-by-claim certification.

records.confirmed_scope_en: Marriage and chastity are subjects to be carefully taught by pastors.
records.limits_en: No exhaustive proof of each anthropological premise or full Scripture collation.

records.confirmed_scope_en: Pius XI teaches ecclesial authority in morals alongside reason's limited access.
records.limits_en: No exemption from explaining reasons or determining the authority level of each application.

records.confirmed_scope_en: Pornography is described in relation to displayed real or simulated acts.
records.limits_en: No specific rule on AI images or every privately held synthetic depiction.

records.confirmed_scope_en: Modesty entails prudent avoidance of occasions of temptation.
records.limits_en: Direct audience is clergy in formation, not modern social-media users.

records.confirmed_scope_en: Object, end and circumstances all matter for judging moral action.
records.limits_en: No explicit ruling on erotic fiction, art or clinical materials.

records.confirmed_scope_en: Self-knowledge, ascetic discipline, virtue and prayer are means of resisting temptation.
records.limits_en: No prescription of digital filters or particular addiction protocols.

records.confirmed_scope_en: Church teaching affirms human dignity and presents anthropology of sexual difference.
records.limits_en: No pediatric diagnosis, clinical care plan or universal gender-care treatment algorithm.

records.confirmed_scope_en: Assistance to the conjugal act differs morally from substituting a technical act.
records.limits_en: No detailed approval list of diagnostic specimen-collection methods.

records.confirmed_scope_en: Violence is against the will and produces involuntariness.
records.limits_en: This moral text does not study involuntary bodily arousal; the cited 2024 review supports occurrence but not frequency.

records.confirmed_scope_en: Circumstances can introduce a further moral evil or aggravating element.
records.limits_en: No specific clerical-abuse safeguarding procedures or empirical prevalence.

records.confirmed_scope_en: Violence and fear can impair the voluntariness of actions.
records.limits_en: No direct account of the modern concept of grooming or its typical stages.

records.locator: What Is Consent?; What Consent Is Not; If You Didn't or Couldn't Consent
records.confirmed_scope_en: Consent cannot be inferred from silence or freezing and cannot be coerced by threats.
records.limits_en: Victim-support guidance is not a universal legal code or a theological authority.

records.confirmed_scope_en: Parents have a prior responsibility and right to educate their children.
records.limits_en: No specifically evidenced digital-pornography-response protocol.

records.confirmed_scope_en: Deliberately displaying sexual acts as pornography violates chastity and dignity.
records.limits_en: Not every private consensual image exchange is thereby directly classified as pornography.

records.confirmed_scope_en: Conjugal honor requires fidelity and respect for married partners.
records.limits_en: No explicit ruling on private spousal images or quantification of privacy risk.

records.confirmed_scope_en: Marital fidelity concerns exclusive acts and intentionally entertained desires.
records.limits_en: Virtual worlds and culpability of particular online interactions are not discussed.

records.confirmed_scope_en: Chastity is a virtue concerned with governing sexual desires.
records.limits_en: No specific classification of each interaction with synthetic AI agents.

records.locator: Penance, Confession Q80; Sixth/Ninth Commandments QQ4–5
records.confirmed_scope_en: Doubtful sins need not be confessed; intrusive thoughts are not culpable without consent.
records.limits_en: No medical diagnosis or universal protocol for clinical scrupulosity.

records.locator: Sixth/Ninth Commandments QQ4–5; Penance, Confession Q80
records.confirmed_scope_en: Unbidden thoughts differ from culpably entertained thoughts; confession is not mandatory for uncertain sins.
records.limits_en: No clinical OCD treatment standard and no inference that every uncertain movement was involuntary.

records.confirmed_scope_en: Confession can remit sin and aid against future relapse.
records.limits_en: No guarantee that habitual sins cease immediately.

records.confirmed_scope_en: Dignity and respect for persons should accompany discussion of objective moral claims.
records.limits_en: Letter addresses a specific topic, not a complete generic communications method.
